{"standalone":"How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?","search_queries":["antecipação de recebíveis Getnet como funciona"],"intent":"faq","plan":["faq"],"language":"en","confidence":0.9}

input.query: How does receivables advance (antecipação de recebíveis) work with Getnet?

content.text:
Getnet lets you receive your credit sales early, whether they were paid upfront or in installments, through the Getnet Brasil app for Android and iOS [1]. There is no extra fee to use the app [5].

**In the app:**
- Log in and go to Services, then Antecipação de Vendas [1][4].
- The screen shows the amount available to advance and your registered bank accounts. Choose the account that will receive the money [4].
- Accept the terms, then run the simulation. It shows the amounts, card brands and fees [4].
- Confirm, check the final amount, click Antecipar and enter your password [4].
- Track the request under "Meus Pedidos". The minimum to advance is R$50,00 [4].

**Automatic advance:** you can enable it in the Portal under "Produtos e Serviços". Enabling it is free, but an advance only happens if you have a balance of at least R$ 50,00 [3]. It is also a condition for the exemption on the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" receiving plan. Getnet reviews each contract individually to decide whether to grant it, because it involves credit approval [2].

The passages don't give the fee percentage for advancing. The app simulation shows the fees before you confirm [4].

{"standalone":"How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?","search_queries":["crediário número máximo de parcelas venda"],"intent":"faq","plan":["faq"],"language":"en","confidence":0.9}

input.query: How many installments can I split a sale into with the crediário?

content.text:
You can split a sale into up to 48 installments with the Crediário, and your customer pays the installments on their credit card [1][3]. The maximum term and the interest rate depend on the card issuer, so the limit can be lower for some cards [2]. You receive the full sale amount in a single payment within 2 business days after the transaction is captured, whatever the number of installments. The discount fee is subtracted from the original amount [5].

For comparison, the Parcelado Emissor modality is a different product and allows up to 24 installments [4].
